findings.summary: The integrated AUDIT-011 causal LastWriteTimeUtc probes changed one destination file and one directory without restoring their original timestamps before the idempotence rerun.
findings.upstream_behavior: The fixed upstream commit has no cache-preparation or synthetic audit equivalent. This is downstream workflow behavior and is intentionally replaced for the modern Fabric Player-readiness boundary.
findings.incompatibility_at_base: At exact master base f6273467710f596276183a808f34333d6bf3457e, the file and directory probes wrote and read back the fixed 2001-02-03T04:05:06Z and 2002-03-04T05:06:07Z values, then proceeded directly to the rerun snapshot without restoring the originals. The base suite still exited 0 because that rerun snapshot was taken after the mutations, making the no-mutation comparison a false positive.
findings.replacement: Capture the original UTC values before each probe, run the existing snapshot assertions after the causal write, and restore the original value in an exception-safe finally path. Set-LastWriteTimeUtcAndVerify verifies each restoration read-back. Forced file and directory assertion failures exercise the same path, and a complete post-restoration snapshot must equal the pre-probe snapshot before idempotence is tested.
